function.name: time_converter
function.description: Converts the local time of user's region to the target region's local time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_timezone.description: The timezone of the user in string format. Example: 'Pacific Time (US & Canada)'

target_timezone.description: The target timezone in string format where user wants to know the local time. Example: 'Eastern Time (US & Canada)'

time.description: The local time of user's timezone in string format (24 hr format). Optional parameter. Example: '15:30:00'

message.content: 截至 2024 年底，紐約市（New York City）的估計人口約為 8.5 百萬人。若你想知道整個紐約州（New York State）的總人口，則大約是 19.5 百萬人。這些數字都是根據最新的人口普查和估算資料，實際數字會隨時間略有變動。

We can use the function time_converter? No, that's for time conversion. There's no function for population. So we just answer. We should provide the approximate population. According to latest estimates, New York City population ~8.5 million. But maybe they want the population of New York state? The question says "紐約現在的人口是多少？" Could be ambiguous: "New York" could refer to New York City or New York State. Usually "紐約" refers to New York City. So answer: about 8.5 million. Provide approximate.
